title: Gopher SSC adapter: executable read path, authority-separated mutations
summary: The read-only SSC machine protocol and Finder-authorised Gopher companion adapter now provide fixed-schema status, identify, compare, impact, source and proposals operations. Arbitrary shell/osc execution is still forbidden. Acceptance and proposal decisions remain intentionally unimplemented in this adapter.
invariants: Every executable read first resolves an authorised Gopher ServiceProxy for the requested sphere and role.
The adapter accepts only the exact external.semantic-source-control.machine.<operation> implementation id returned by Finder.
No arbitrary shell command or osc flag surface is exposed; the adapter emits a fixed argv vector into semantic.source.control.machine/0.1.
Read-only negative outcomes such as NOT_FOUND/UNCHANGED/REVIEW_REQUIRED keep tool_status OK and never trigger a bypass/fallback around Finder.
Mutations remain outside the executable adapter and require explicit reviewer/admin authority plus stale fences when implemented.
Result pages are projections; durable history remains in SSC.
